examples.t: Speed matters — we take calculated risks, learn, and iterate.
We move with speed on what matters most and take the time to invest in what will make us faster tomorrow.
We believe that it’s better to move fast and make mistakes than to move slowly and miss opportunities.
Most companies cobble together a latticework of separate tools as they grow, but the weight of disorganization and lack of order collapses and eventually catches up to them.
As companies grow, they often become highly centralized and inflexible.
Our organization is very flat, and the people making product decisions are also the ones implementing them.
We gracefully manage ambiguity, cultivate innovation, and demonstrate an insatiable desire to learn.
Acting with courage, challenging the status quo and finding new ways to grow our company and each other.
They are externally aware, look for new ideas from everywhere, and are not limited by “not invented here." As we do new things, we accept that we may be misunderstood for long periods of time.

quote.t: cultivate innovation, and demonstrate an insatiable desire to learn

examples.t: "Going against inertia is an act of care." — Tobi Even if we get everything right, some projects simply will not work.
But those are the exceptions, and we avoid over-correcting.
Even if the full pitch doesn’t make it in, it can impact other product decisions by shining light on a weak point.

quote.t: shining light on a weak point

examples.t: We over-index on transparency because we believe access to information is imperative to creating the very best work, and we have a lot to learn from one another.
We are candid and transparent and seek excellence in all that we do.
We create a culture where we are straightforward and willing to have hard conversations with each other.

quote.t: straightforward and willing to have hard conversations

examples.t: Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
You accomplish amazing amounts of important work You demonstrate consistently strong performance so colleagues can rely upon you You focus on results over process It’s easy to write admirable values;
But for those who embrace the challenge, it can be the most impactful work of your career.

quote.t: Bring passion and dedication to your job

examples.t: But unconditional allegiance to a stagnant firm, or to a merely-adequately-performing employee, is not what we are about.
We are not here to manage the appearance of work.
We don’t look to the industry or our competitors for the way forward.
We’re proud of our accomplishments, but we have much more work to do.
We’re investing great effort, and we’re improving—but we recognize we have a long way to go.
We know that our work is far from over and that the challenges that lie before us are great.

quote.t: we have a long way to go

examples.t: We strive to build products that are easy to use, trusted, and that our customers love.
We care deeply about the products we build for our customers.
We keep our customers at the core of everything that we do.

quote.t: keep our customers at the core of everything

examples.t: Like all great companies, we strive to hire the best and we value integrity, excellence, respect, inclusivity, and collaboration.
We put great stock in our employees–energetic, passionate people from diverse backgrounds with creative approaches to work, play and life.
We believe that hard work and innovative solutions result in big gains, so we prioritize hiring top talent and cultivating a culture based on merit.

quote.t: prioritize hiring top talent and cultivating

examples.t: This document is about our internal employee culture: the unusual ways we work together so we can eventually entertain everyone.
Outlining our culture helps everyone — from candidates to new leaders to veteran employees — understand how we interact and get work done in service of our mission.
Our culture is all about working together to make a difference, and we’re dedicated to creating a positive, engaging environment where everyone can thrive.

quote.t: how we interact and get work done

examples.t: Too many young people face systemic barriers to opportunity due to lack of education and/or skills needed to enter the workforce.
Yet too many of them lack access to the support, mentoring, technology, and platforms to make the most of their talent.
Although hiring and investing in the talent of tomorrow is critical—and we’ll continue our work here—it’s not enough.

quote.t: lack access to the support, mentoring, technology, and platforms

examples.t: We’ll help you maintain a healthy balance with a gym allowance, parental leave, childcare benefits, flexible work hours, and catered meals to give you more time for the things you care about most.
From our flexible, project-based approach to corporate structure to our innovative perks and benefits, we do everything we can to make sure our employees not only have great jobs, but great lives.

We encourage our team to use our standard flexibility, designated volunteer hours and unlimited PTO policies to find the time and space they need to handle life’s challenges so they can return to work

quote.t: find the time and space they need

examples.t: You’ll find a culture of collaboration, trust, and innovation — along with the tools and support to make a real impact right from day one.
Join us and you’ll do the best work of your life — and make a difference in other people’s lives.
You will enjoy collaborative relationships, visibility into all parts of the business, and opportunities to do real, impactful work.

quote.t: make a real impact right from day one

examples.t: We are a company of builders who bring varying backgrounds, ideas, and points of view to inventing on behalf of our customers.
Together, we chart new paths, drive customer success, develop AI-first technology, and build a better world.
We work quickly and collaboratively to build smarter, more meaningful solutions on a global scale.

quote.t: work quickly and collaboratively to build

examples.t: We believe we can all become a part of something bigger and inspire positive change in the world around us.
We take care of each other, have fun together, and work collaboratively to make the world a better place.
We’re united with our community to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere.

quote.t: work collaboratively to make the world a better place

examples.t: At the forefront of innovation, the possibilities are endless Work with the brightest AI minds to build the future of human connection.
We’re working to develop artificial intelligence responsibly.
At the world’s trusted #1 AI CRM, humans and AI agents collaborate to drive efficiency, growth, and workforce transformation.

quote.t: humans and AI agents collaborate to drive

examples.t: We’re continuing to create a culture of inclusion, increasing representation across teams, and holding ourselves accountable at every level.
We care deeply about improving workforce representation and creating an inclusive culture for everyone.
We strive to create a workplace that reflects the diverse communities around us and where everyone feels seen, heard, valued, and empowered to succeed.
We recently shared our annual 2017 pay equity analyses publicly.
Last year we reported the demographics of our employees for the first time externally, although we have long prioritized diversity.
We continuously assess and aim for pay equity across the entire organization.

quote.t: continuously assess and aim for pay equity

examples.t: Our Equality groups are employee-led, open to all, and support our business through engagement, innovation, retention, and cultivating leadership skills.
We are proud to support the Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that provide additional support and community for underrepresented employees and their allies.
Our programs, employee-led resource groups, and events are open to all.
